_about: Revision 2 header and footer data (FOUNDATION-R2), written from docs/REVISION-2.md 'Header' and 'Footer': the nav order, mega-menu groups and footer columns follow the large multi-state operator's site; every item is a Star Buds page or a Star Buds source. Rendered by src/theme/shell.mjs. A group with "from" is filled at build time: "site.categories" = the 9 shop categories of site.json as live-menu links (data-menu-cat, rewritten by site.js); "resources/products.json" = the product guides RESOURCES-R2 writes ({guides:[{slug,label,href}]}), else "fallback"; "blog/vibes.json" = the reading list BLOG-R2 writes ({items:[{label,href,title}]}), else "fallback"; "site.storesByState" = the 12 shop stores of site.json by state. Notes ("note") are neutral UI glue and state no Star Buds fact.

promo._omitted: Delivery (no shop-state delivery in the sources), My Account (no Star Buds accounts on this site), chat (none).
